subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. He started assembling the deck planks, fastening each one in a neat, even line.

Q. He made sure that every angle was precisely square when he constructed the deck with beams and joists.

R. He prepared the foundation by excavating holes and positioning the building's columns.

S. He took a step back and admired the new outdoor area, a sturdy deck that was made to stay.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. R, Q, P, S .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sequence of events in the paragraph describes the process of constructing a deck step by step, starting with the foundation and ending with admiration of the final product.
 
• The correct sequence is as follows:
 
 
• **R:** Preparing the foundation by excavating holes and positioning the building's columns.
 
• **Q:** Constructing the deck with beams and joists, ensuring precise angles.
 
• **P:** Assembling the deck planks in a neat, even line.
 
• **S:** Admiring the completed sturdy deck.
 
 
 
• This logical order ensures that the steps are described in a meaningful and grammatically correct manner.

Correct sentence sequence: *R, Q, P, S*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When solving such rearrangement questions:
 
 
• Identify the logical sequence of events or ideas.
 
• Look for connecting words, phrases, or steps to help determine the proper order.
 
• Ensure that the paragraph flows naturally and grammatically correct.
